description: The renderer->plugin grants Houston needs, each reopened per D18's own falsification clause rather than worked around; everything else stays Rust-side commands with no entry except the narrow taskbar and frameless-titlebar grants below. (1) core:event — the watchdog subscribes to wd:* Tauri events, and core:event is ACL-gated like any plugin (D49, 2026-08-09). (2) core:webview:allow-internal-toggle-devtools — Tauri's own built-in Ctrl+Shift+I handler invokes it, so without the grant the shortcut silently does nothing AND leaves an unhandled rejection in the console (D53, 2026-08-10, found by the manual script). Narrow permission, not core:webview:default: this is the one command that handler calls. Inert in a release build, which compiles no inspector to toggle. (3) core:window:allow-set-badge-count and allow-set-overlay-icon — the renderer updates the taskbar attention count with Tauri badge APIs on Linux/macOS and an overlay icon on Windows. (4) core:window:allow-start-dragging and allow-internal-toggle-maximize — Tauri's injected drag-region script calls both for `data-tauri-drag-region` bars (drag, and maximize on double-click). (5) allow-minimize, allow-toggle-maximize, allow-close and allow-is-maximized — the frameless titlebar's own window buttons and their state read.
